- Introduce stakeholders and owners from both sides
- Walk through a proposed hands-on agenda (prompt review, routing policies, and security boundaries)
- Lock in a slot for the performance trials/load test (concurrent streams, sequence lengths, and success targets)

- Option A: Mon 11/23 10:00–11:00
- Option B: Tue 11/24 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm which slot works and confirm attendees? Wonderful — lock confirmed for Tue 11/24 14:00–15:00 PT (60 minutes).

I just sent the calendar invite (subject: BlueAcre / Redwood POC Orientation — 11/24 14:00 PT) and included the pre-call checklist and attendee roles in the description. Quick notes before the call:
- Pre-call checklist (short):
  • Jason: temporary service account + IAM roles described in the checklist (we ask for sts:AssumeRole or equivalent for the test window)
  • Samir: ensure VPC peering or a test subnet ready for the harness (we'll list ports)
  • Aisha: two representative prompt sets (one routing-heavy, one routing-light) uploaded to the shared folder
- Success criteria (to be confirmed on the call):
  • Prompt fidelity: responses meet the labeled acceptance set in the prompt review (70%+ pass on first-run relevance)
  • Performance: 15 concurrent sessions with <350ms p95 inference latency in our configured shard profile
  • Reliability: The harness completes 30 minutes of sustained load without error spikes >1%

Marissa will present the harness approach and proposed kernel/quantization options; Karthik will capture owners and scheduling for the hands-on lab. If anything changes, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Look forward to it.
